footer.tagline: Bridging generations through collaborative quests, AI mentoring, and shared wisdom.

landing.seoTitle: Rootwise — Activities With Parents & Grandparents | Intergenerational Platform
landing.seoDescription: Discover meaningful activities to do with your parents, grandparents or grandchildren. Rootwise connects generations through shared Quests, AI mentoring and community — combat loneliness and build lasting family bonds. Free to join.
landing.heroDescription: Rootwise pairs life experience with modern skills. Create your profile, join a quest, and grow with a mentor and a community that cares.
landing.heroImageAlt: A younger person and an older person laughing together at a laptop — bridging generations through shared learning
landing.heroImageCaption: Real connections. Real learning. Across generations.
landing.howItWorksTitle: Three steps to your first quest
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: From sign-up to meaningful connection in minutes
landing.step1Desc: Tell us who you are. Are you looking to share your life experience (Sage) or learn new skills (Seeker)? Build a profile to find the right match.
landing.step2Desc: Pick a topic and connect. Choose a specific activity—like “Fixing a Camera” or “Learning TikTok”—and start a guided video call with built-in conversation starters.
landing.step3Desc: Capture the wisdom. Save the best moments from the call, earn XP for helping others, and build a digital timeline of skills and stories.
landing.examplesSubtitle: Here are real examples of activities people do on Rootwise.
landing.exampleCookingDesc: Grandma Malle teaches how to bake real sourdough bread in a kitchen video call.
landing.exampleTechDesc: Markus (19) teaches grandpa how to avoid online scams.
landing.exampleHistoryDesc: Ene (75) shows old photos on camera and shares stories from the 1980 Olympics.
landing.whySubtitle: Society is fractured by age silos. Rootwise is the bridge.
landing.problem1Desc: Loneliness is a global epidemic. Rootwise replaces passive scrolling with active, meaningful human partnership across generations.
landing.problem2Desc: Millions of years of life experience are locked away. We turn those memories into actionable quests that preserve cultural legacy.
landing.problem3Desc: No more "digital divide". Seniors teach soft skills and history; youth teach modern technology and digital leverage.
landing.feature1Desc: Collaborative challenges that pair different generations to learn from each other.
landing.feature2Desc: Powered by Gemini AI — your personal guide for learning, quests, and growth.
landing.feature3Desc: Join groups around shared interests — cooking, tech, gardening, storytelling, and more.
landing.feature4Desc: Earn experience points, level up, and track your wisdom journey over time.
landing.conversionDesc: Create a profile, pick your first quest, and get paired with a mentor. No paywall to get started.
landing.conversionReadingAlt: An older woman peacefully reading a book on a sunny porch — wisdom worth sharing
landing.faq1A: Yes. Core features are free and you can start without a credit card.
landing.faq2A: Your profile and conversation settings are in your control. You can change visibility or remove content anytime.
landing.faq3A: Create an account, choose roles and interests, then join a quest. Your first recommendations arrive automatically.
landing.finalCtaDesc: Join the movement where every interaction is an investment in our collective future. Start your first quest today.

howWorks.seoDesc: A simple guide to every Rootwise feature, with examples for users, families, schools, and care homes.
howWorks.title: Everything you can do on Rootwise
howWorks.subtitle: A simple step-by-step guide for ages 10 to 100. No jargon, just clear examples.
howWorks.journeySubtitle: Start small, grow naturally, and repeat what works for you.
howWorks.step1Desc: Choose your role, add your interests and skills, and set up your basic info so others can find a good match.
howWorks.step1Example: Example: Sara adds gardening and storytelling to her profile.
howWorks.step2Desc: Browse quests by topic or let AI generate one based on your interests.
howWorks.step2Example: Example: Create a quest about smartphone basics for beginners.
howWorks.step3Desc: Use chat, files, milestones, and video calls to complete your quest as a team.
howWorks.step3Example: Example: Share photos, tick milestones, and finish a 30-minute call.
howWorks.step4Desc: Earn XP, level up, and see your growth over time.
howWorks.step4Example: Example: After 3 completed quests, your level and XP increase.
howWorks.step5Desc: Join communities, get AI suggestions, and connect with people who match your goals.
howWorks.step5Example: Example: You join a local community and find a mentor match.
howWorks.featuresSubtitle: What each feature does, why it helps, and how to use it.
howWorks.featureProfileBenefit: Helps people understand what you can teach and what you want to learn.
howWorks.featureProfileUsage: Set your role (Sage, Seeker, Hybrid), add skills/interests, and update your location and language.
howWorks.featureQuestsBenefit: Turns big goals into practical, motivating activities.
howWorks.featureQuestsUsage: Open the Quests page, filter by category, join one, or generate a new quest with AI.
howWorks.featureQuestRoomBenefit: Keeps everything for one quest in one place.
howWorks.featureQuestRoomUsage: Inside quest details, chat with members, upload helpful files, track milestones, and submit proof.
howWorks.featureVideoBenefit: Makes collaboration personal and easier, especially across generations.
howWorks.featureVideoUsage: Start or join a call from quest details and work through steps together live.
howWorks.featureCommunityUsage: Join communities, view members, and participate in activities with people around your topics.
howWorks.featureAiBenefit: Gives ideas, guidance, and connection suggestions when you are stuck.
howWorks.featureAiUsage: Open Nexus AI, ask practical questions, and use match suggestions to start intros.
howWorks.featureMatchingBenefit: Finds people with compatible goals faster.
howWorks.featureMatchingUsage: Open Matching, review top suggestions, and connect in one click.
howWorks.featureAnalyticsBenefit: Shows what is improving and where to focus next.
howWorks.featureAnalyticsUsage: View XP trends, completion rate, skill coverage, and AI usage from the Analytics page.
howWorks.featureOrganizerBenefit: Helps care homes and larger groups run programs with less admin work.
howWorks.featureOrganizerUsage: Use Admin Dashboard to manage members, create communities, generate starter/weekly programs, copy join links, and export reports.
howWorks.featureNotificationsBenefit: Keeps everyone informed and supports a safer community.
howWorks.featureNotificationsUsage: Use the bell icon for updates and the report page to report issues, bugs, or inappropriate content.
howWorks.examplesSubtitle: How different people use Rootwise in everyday life.
howWorks.exampleFamilyText: A teenager teaches online safety to a grandparent, then the grandparent shares old family photo stories.
howWorks.exampleSchoolText: Students create a history quest with local seniors and collect stories as part of class work.
howWorks.exampleCareHomeText: Staff creates a weekly plan, invites volunteers via join link, and tracks resident participation.
howWorks.featureAiTranslateBenefit: Lets people from different languages and cultures communicate naturally without losing context.
howWorks.featureAiTranslateUsage: Turn on AI Mediator in messages to translate incoming text and send culture-aware replies. Available on Pro, Org, and Admin plans.
howWorks.aiTierNote: Friendly note: AI Nexus contact starter remains available on Free plans, while AI auto-sync translate in inbox is available on Pro, Org, and Admin plans to keep API costs sustainable.
howWorks.exampleTranslate1Text: A learner writes in Spanish, mentor reads in Estonian, and AI Mediator keeps tone friendly and clear for both sides.
howWorks.exampleTranslate2Text: AI helps shape the first message respectfully, so new contacts feel safe and understood from the start.
howWorks.ctaTitle: Ready to try your first quest?
howWorks.ctaSubtitle: Start simple today. You can always grow step by step.
